Class GameSession

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.it.network.server.GameSession
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameEventListener
public class GameSession extends Object implements GameEventListener
One active game session on the server.

Responsible only for the network layer: managing connections, routing messages to the controller, and broadcasting GameEvents (received from the model via the controller) to all connected clients.

All game logic passes through GameController, which is the proper MVC controller. This class registers itself as a GameEventListener alongside the controller so it can serialise and broadcast events; the controller handles local view feedback (validation errors, logging via StubGameView).

When the GameEvent.GameEnded event arrives the session also:

  • persists every player's score to the leaderboard table via the injected LeaderboardRepository;
  • computes each player's rank among all the games with the same number of participants;
  • sends every client a LEADERBOARD message containing both their personal rank and the complete ranking for that game size.
The persistence step is best-effort: failures are logged but do not abort the game.

    • handleMessage

      public void handleMessage(Message msg, ClientConnection sender)
      Routes an incoming client message to the GameController.

      If the action is rejected (invalid), the controller already logs it via the StubGameView; we additionally send an error message back to the client that sent the bad action.

      Converts model events to network messages and broadcasts them to all clients.
